lesson.title: Practice: New Chord: C major (+ Make easy C)
lesson.one_line_promise: Rehearse Em, easyC until it is automatic.
objectives: Run a 1-minute change count on the pairs in scope
Hit 30 clean changes/min (advance) and aim for 60 (goal)
Let the app remember your weak pairs for spaced review

chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

Em.name: E minor
Em.note: Verified deterministically by chord-theory-check.js (2026-08-08) as E B G.

easyC.name: C major (Lauren's 'easy C' — 2-finger reduction)
easyC.note: Verified deterministically by chord-theory-check.js (2026-08-08) as C E G.

exercises.name: Warm-up: spider + Chord-Perfect
exercises.purpose: Warm the hand, then lock the target voicings accuracy-first.
exercises.coaching: Spider up and down the neck to warm up. Then Chord-Perfect each chord in scope — string by string, no buzz.

exercises.name: 1-minute changes — easyC <-> Em
exercises.purpose: Count completed easyC <-> Em changes in 60s; the 30/60 engine records your rate into fluency memory.
exercises.coaching: Metronome on. easyC to Em, back and forth, as many clean changes as you can in one minute. The app remembers this pair — your weakest pairs come back for spaced review.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: Today we drill what Group 3 taught — clean, even reps, not fast messy ones.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: A higher count than last time means your hands are learning. That is the only metric that matters here.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: Logged to your fluency memory. If a pair is weak, it will resurface in review.

must_verify: Curriculum §5.1: chords_in_scope == cumulative chord set through Group 3 (teaching chord set + everything before).
Engine: one-minute-changes 30/60 counter wired; weak-pair fluency recorded.
qa_block.guitarist_signoff: NOT REQUIRED — chord fingerings verified deterministically by chord-theory-check.js.
